All have left TS, the announced on their insta yesterday. As of Feb 28, 2022. Kangmin, Jihun, Hyunwoo, Hohyeon, Jisung, and Hakmin ended their contracts. Hayoung left on March 16, 2022. Siwoo doesn’t have an insta, but I assume since the others left, he also left. Taeseon and Wooyeop left Nov 18, 2019.

Edit: April 11 - Kangmin, Hyunwoo, Jihun, and Siwoo joined APR Entertainment, 
2023: these 4 are in a boy group called BXB under wolfburn entertainment
July 19: Taeseon joined GGA entertainment
2024 Taeseon is in a boy group called Unname House
